name: Tabbouleh VI
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 cups (480 ml) fresh parsley, finely chopped
1 large tomato, diced with seeds discarded
⅓ cup (80 ml) extra virgin olive oil
½ cup (120 ml) fresh lemon juice

steps: Once water comes to a boil, add bulgur wheat and remove from heat. Let cool.
Drain the bulgur wheat, and mix wheat with all other ingredients.
